newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle Wednesday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle Wednesday roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was active in the Panhandle area Wednesday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers steady with last test. Feedlots reported good inquiry from buyers.
Wk to date - 126,700 Last Week - 89,700 Year Ago - 64,200
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1250 lbs 64.00. Select, few Choice 2-3 1150-1250 lbs 63.00-63.75.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs 64.00. Select, few Choice 2-3 1000-1100 lbs 62.50-63.50.
Sales reported on 43,900 slaughter steers and 28,100 heifers; 126,700 head confirmed for week to date which includes 31,400 formulated cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
